subcommands.name: create-event-source-mapping
subcommands.description: Creates a mapping between an event source and an Lambda function. Lambda reads items from the event source and invokes the function.

options.name: --event-source-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the event source.    Amazon Kinesis – The ARN of the data stream or a stream consumer.

options.name: --function-name
options.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function.  Name formats     Function name – MyFunction.

options.name: --enabled
options.description: When true, the event source mapping is active. When false, Lambda pauses polling and invocation. Default: True

options.name: --no-enabled
options.description: When true, the event source mapping is active. When false, Lambda pauses polling and invocation. Default: True

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: The maximum number of records in each batch that Lambda pulls from your stream or queue and sends to your function.

options.name: --filter-criteria
options.description: An object that defines the filter criteria that determine whether Lambda should process an event. For more information, see Lambda event filtering

options.name: --maximum-batching-window-in-seconds
options.description: The maximum amount of time, in seconds, that Lambda spends gathering records before invoking the function.

options.name: --parallelization-factor
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) The number of batches to process from each shard concurrently

options.name: --starting-position
options.description: The position in a stream from which to start reading. Required for Amazon Kinesis and Amazon DynamoDB Stream event sources.

options.name: --starting-position-timestamp
options.description: With StartingPosition set to AT_TIMESTAMP, the time from which to start reading. StartingPositionTimestamp cannot be in the future

options.name: --destination-config
options.description: (Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, Amazon MSK, and self-managed Kafka only) A configuration object that specifies the destination of an event after Lambda processes it

options.name: --maximum-record-age-in-seconds
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) Discard records older than the specified age. The default value is infinite (-1)

options.name: --bisect-batch-on-function-error
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) If the function returns an error, split the batch in two and retry

options.name: --no-bisect-batch-on-function-error
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) If the function returns an error, split the batch in two and retry

options.name: --maximum-retry-attempts
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) Discard records after the specified number of retries. The default value is infinite (-1).

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of tags to apply to the event source mapping

options.name: --tumbling-window-in-seconds
options.description: (Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams only) The duration in seconds of a processing window for DynamoDB and Kinesis Streams event sources.

options.name: --topics
options.description: The name of the Kafka topic

options.name: --queues
options.description: (MQ) The name of the Amazon MQ broker destination queue to consume

options.name: --source-access-configurations
options.description: An array of authentication protocols or VPC components required to secure your event source

options.name: --self-managed-event-source
options.description: The self-managed Apache Kafka cluster to receive records from

options.name: --function-response-types
options.description: (Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, and Amazon SQS) A list of current response type enums applied to the event source mapping

options.name: --amazon-managed-kafka-event-source-config
options.description: Specific configuration settings for an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) event source

options.name: --self-managed-kafka-event-source-config
options.description: Specific configuration settings for a self-managed Apache Kafka event source

options.name: --scaling-config
options.description: (Amazon SQS only) The scaling configuration for the event source. For more information, see Configuring maximum concurrency for Amazon SQS event sources

options.name: --document-db-event-source-config
options.description: Specific configuration settings for a DocumentDB event source

options.name: --kms-key-arn
options.description: The ARN of the Key Management Service (KMS) customer managed key that Lambda uses to encrypt your function's filter criteria.

options.name: --metrics-config
options.description: The metrics configuration for your event source. For more information, see Event source mapping metrics

options.name: --provisioned-poller-config
options.description: (Amazon MSK and self-managed Apache Kafka only) The Provisioned Mode configuration for the event source. For more information, see Provisioned Mode

subcommands.name: create-function
subcommands.description: Creates a Lambda function. To create a function, you need a deployment package and an execution role.

options.name: --function-name
options.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function.  Name formats     Function name – my-function.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: The identifier of the function's  runtime. Runtime is required if the deployment package is a .zip file archive.

options.name: --role
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the function's execution role

options.name: --handler
options.description: The name of the method within your code that Lambda calls to run your function. Handler is required if the deployment package is a .zip file archive.

options.name: --code
options.description: The code for the function

options.name: --description
options.description: A description of the function

options.name: --timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in seconds) that Lambda allows a function to run before stopping it. The default is 3 seconds. The maximum allowed value is 900 seconds.

options.name: --memory-size
options.description: The amount of memory available to the function at runtime. Increasing the function memory also increases its CPU allocation. The default value is 128 MB.

options.name: --publish
options.description: Set to true to publish the first version of the function during creation

options.name: --no-publish
options.description: Set to true to publish the first version of the function during creation

options.name: --vpc-config
options.description: For network connectivity to Amazon Web Services resources in a VPC, specify a list of security groups and subnets in the VPC.

options.name: --package-type
options.description: The type of deployment package. Set to Image for container image and set to Zip for .zip file archive

options.name: --dead-letter-config
options.description: A dead-letter queue configuration that specifies the queue or topic where Lambda sends asynchronous events when they fail processing.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment variables that are accessible from function code during execution

options.name: --kms-key-arn
options.description: The ARN of the Key Management Service (KMS) customer managed key that's used to encrypt the following resources:   The function's environment variables.

options.name: --tracing-config
options.description: Set Mode to Active to sample and trace a subset of incoming requests with X-Ray

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of tags to apply to the function

options.name: --layers
options.description: A list of function layers to add to the function's execution environment. Specify each layer by its ARN, including the version

options.name: --file-system-configs
options.description: Connection settings for an Amazon EFS file system

options.name: --image-config
options.description: Container image configuration values that override the values in the container image Dockerfile

options.name: --code-signing-config-arn
options.description: To enable code signing for this function, specify the ARN of a code-signing configuration.

options.name: --architectures
options.description: The instruction set architecture that the function supports. Enter a string array with one of the valid values (arm64 or x86_64). The default value is x86_64

options.name: --ephemeral-storage
options.description: The size of the function's /tmp directory in MB. The default value is 512, but can be any whole number between 512 and 10,240 MB.

options.name: --snap-start
options.description: The function's SnapStart setting

options.name: --logging-config
options.description: The function's Amazon CloudWatch Logs configuration settings

options.name: --zip-file
options.description: The path to the zip file of the code you are uploading. Specify --zip-file or --code, but not both. Example: fileb://code.zip
